'''The Hexagon''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] term used to refer to an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] situated along the border of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the region was a hotspot of Rebel activity. Under the direction of its owner and Rebel sympathizer [[Meysen Kayson]], the [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]], which ran highly profitable [[greel tree]]&ndash;[[logging]] operations in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector's]] [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]], diverted<ref name="Journal6" /> significant<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|38|Hexagon, the}}</ref> funds to many Alliance operations in the Hexagon.<ref name="Journal6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hexagon was first mentioned in "[[The Greel Wood Haven]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and published in the [[May]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Journal6" />
